verdict.rationale: Docusign is an e-signature and agreement-management platform. Acting as a statutory registered agent, with a physical state address, mail scanning and service-of-process handling, is outside that product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Docusign offers a registered agent service, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the platform as my registered agent and receive scanned legal mail and service of process digitally
